mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose from portal blood through glycogen storage and release was worthwhile: the sequence connects a familiar carbohydrate to the liver's role between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final integration was less informative than the storage sequence: the picture plan names blood, nerve and lymph connections without explaining their individual roles.

surprise.text: The sequence clarified that stored glycogen can be broken down and its glucose carried to other tissues between meals.

arbitrary.text: Fitting the portal vessel was clearly prompted by the named slot, though the fitting itself did not show the route in detail.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the connected systems support further functions, though I would hope for more detail about their interactions than the final integration provided.
